caption: The store account for furniture still has four months left and I didn't budget for that part of moving out. What did nobody warn you about?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R25 800
p/m salary
Living in Centurion
slides.body:
Female, 27
Single, just moved into her first own flat
Job: Radiographer, private hospital
Net salary: R25 800 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: First place with my name on the lease. It's smaller than I pictured and I still love it.

slides.title: Furniture & moving store account
slides.includes: Bed, couch and a fridge, on a 6 month store account
slides.body: Four months left. I underestimated how much a place costs before you've even lived in it.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Woolworths mostly, Checkers when I'm being sensible
slides.body: Cooking for one still feels like a waste some nights.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: The one bill that hasn't changed since I moved.

slides.title: Streaming & a gym I haven't used
slides.includes: Three streaming apps, a gym membership from January
slides.body: I told myself it was maybe R400. It's R950, and I've been to the gym twice since March.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol, medical aid, phone & fibre, funeral policy, stokvel, insurance, savings
slides.body: Seven things I'd never once had to think about together while I still lived at home.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R25 800. Living alone costs more than I budgeted for, in ways I hadn't priced in before I moved.

slides.title: I stopped guessing what living alone actually costs
slides.body:
I uploaded my first two months of statements as a tenant to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction for me.

The streaming apps and the gym I hadn't used since March were the numbers that got me.

No bank login needed.
